gloss: to adapt; to adjust; to acclimate

definitions.gloss: to adapt; to adjust; to acclimate
definitions.explanation: To change oneself or one's behavior in response to new conditions or circumstances. Used for both biological adaptation and personal adjustment to new environments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{適応|てきおう}する。
examples.english: To adapt to a new environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学先|りゅうがくさき}→留学先：09976_ryuugakusaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ようやく⟦{適応|てきおう}→適応：14382_tekiou⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I finally managed to adjust to life at my study abroad destination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{適応|てきおう}して⟦{生|い}き{延|の}びて→生き延びる：21713_ikinobiru⟧きた。
examples.english: Animals have survived by adapting even to harsh climates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{適応|てきおう}しきれて⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I just changed jobs and haven't fully adjusted to the culture of my new workplace yet.

notes:
Composed of {適|てき} (suitable, fitting) and {応|おう} (respond, apply). Describes the process of becoming suited to new conditions. Can be used for both biological/evolutionary adaptation and everyday personal adjustment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{適応|てきおう}する: to adapt to an environment
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{適応|てきおう}する: to adjust to society
- ⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{適応|てきおう}する: to adapt to changes
- ⟦{適応|てきおう}→適応：14382_tekiou⟧⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧: adaptability
- ⟦{適応|てきおう}{障害|しょうがい}→適応障害：08598_tekioushougai⟧: adjustment disorder

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧: to get used to — focuses on becoming accustomed through familiarity; more casual
- ⟦{順応|じゅんのう}→順応：14949_junnou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to acclimate — similar meaning but emphasizes conforming to surroundings; slightly more formal
- ⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to respond, deal with — focuses on taking action in response to a situation, not changing oneself
